title: Natural cohomological section comparison under successive base change
statement: Fix shared derived-category localizations [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X→S be flat proper locally of finite presentation [def-weil-flat-morphism,def-weil-proper-morphism,def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], let L be invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], and let k:W→S be any scheme morphism. Put E=R(pr_W)_*((pr_X^*L)[0]) on W [def-pc-derived-direct-image,def-pc-base-change,def-pc-module-pullback]. There is a family of additive equivalences q_t:P(E,t)≃Γ(X×_S T,L_T) for all t:T→W, where P and its restriction are [def-sc-picard-derived-model-sections]. For i:T′→T, t′:T′→W and h:i≫t=t′, take any j:X×_S T′→X×_S T whose first projection equals pr_X and whose second projection equals pr_T′≫i. Let c:P_prX′≅P_prX⋙P_j be the inverse mate of the canonical pushforward composition followed by transport along j≫pr_X=pr_X′, using the adjunctions pinned by [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Then (c.app L).inv, applied at top after the presheaf restriction from j inverse top to top of the tensor-adjunction unit on q_t(ξ), equals q_t′ of the derived restriction of ξ. There is no assertion about the image of j, no residue point, and no open neighbourhood in this lemma.

proof.text: Use picardDirectImageSectionMap_bijective to equip each actual additive comparison map with AddEquiv.ofBijective. For every successive base change apply picardDirectImageSectionMap_restriction. Its map is definitionally the underlying map of these equivalences.

theorem picard_direct_image_section_naturality
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) :
    let E := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))
    ∃ q : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (t : T ⟶ W),
        picardDerivedModelSections E t ≃+
          Γ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k))).obj L, ⊤),
      ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (t : T ⟶ W) (t' : T' ⟶ W)
        (h : i ≫ t = t')
        (j : pullback f (t' ≫ k) ⟶ pullback f (t ≫ k)),
        ∀ (hj₁ : j ≫ pullback.fst f (t ≫ k) = pullback.fst f (t' ≫ k)),
          j ≫ pullback.snd f (t ≫ k) = pullback.snd f (t' ≫ k) ≫ i →
          let c := (conjugateIsoEquiv
            ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
              (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k)))).comp
                (Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)))
            (Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
              (pullback.fst f (t' ≫ k))))).symm
            (Modules.pushforwardComp j (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k)) ≪≫
              Modules.pushforwardCongr hj₁)
          ∀ ξ : picardDerivedModelSections E t,
            (c.app L).inv.app ⊤
              (((Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
                ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k))).obj L)).presheaf.map
                  (homOfLE j.preimage_top.ge).op
                    (((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
                      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k))).obj L)).val.app
                        (Opposite.op ⊤) (q t ξ))) =
              q t' (picardDerivedModelRestriction E i t t' h ξ)
